title: Underwater Arcology: Principles and Idea Lineage
t: Underwater Arcology: Principles and Idea Lineage
description:
Principles of the Underwater Arcology. Habitat concepts trade capacity, self-sufficiency, comfort, and construction effort. Each generation houses more people more comfortably with less resupply.

The idea lineage: early speculation imagined the effect; bench prototypes proved the principle; refinement generations compounded performance; the mature form in this archive represents the best understood version of the concept.
